_source.cost_usd: Pydantic Evals ReportCase.metrics['cost'] when available; main-agent estimated cost is reported under usage_split.main.cost_usd
_source.runtime_s: wall-clock time around agent.run(...) in evals.bo_mcp.runner

architecture._source: best-effort architecture compliance derived from selected eval mode, main-agent tool calls, subagent task handles, and generated workspace files

architecture_restrictions.execution_style: specialist authors and smoke-tests script; main agent executes full campaign and reports

mode_violation_reasons: standard mode requires a completed bo-pyscf-specialist delegation

bo_mcp._source: BO-MCP REST read-back of campaign, spec, results, and diagnostics endpoints

metric_notes: Token and cost fields are reported only when exposed by the runtime or derivable from recorded message metadata.
Subagent metrics use TaskHandle observability fields when the installed subagent runtime exposes them, with older-runtime fallbacks.

_source.combined: sum of available main/subagent counters; cost may be incomplete when subagent cost is unavailable
_source.main: Pydantic AI result.usage plus result.all_messages() for message-level cost metadata
_source.subagents: best-effort top-level subagent task handles from agent._task_manager.list_handles()

_source.cost_usd: main plus subagent cost only when all required cost components are available

combined.cost_incomplete_reason: subagent task handles did not expose cost or enough model/provider metadata for estimation

limitations: subagent usage is read from top-level pydantic-deep task handles
combined assumes parent AgentRunResult.usage excludes subagent TaskHandle.usage; this assumption should be retested after dependency changes
per-task subagent tool-call counts require TaskHandle.tool_call_counts or TaskHandle.message_history

_source.cost_usd: genai-prices estimate from main-agent response message usage/model metadata
TaskHandle.cost when exposed, otherwise genai-prices estimate from task-handle usage and model/provider metadata
_source.messages: TaskHandle.message_history when exposed by the installed subagent runtime
_source.tool_call_counts: TaskHandle.tool_call_counts when exposed, otherwise counts derived from TaskHandle.message_history tool-call parts
_source.usage: best-effort top-level subagent task handles from agent._task_manager.list_handles()

tasks.description:
Author a BO-MCP campaign script and HOW_TO_EXECUTE_CAMPAIGN.md for a controlled synthetic benchmark: optimize the 6D Ackley surface using BO-MCP architecture, but DO NOT call PySCF, CREST, MOF, RAISE, or any chemistry/experimental evaluator. Use a deterministic local Python objective function only. Requirements:

- Campaign must create/use only BO-MCP campaigns whose names include the exact marker `akg-eval-33269dad0b2d4893af291cb6d2b01f22`.
- Do not create, resume, or report any campaign lacking that exact marker.
- Include this marker in delegated/generated artifacts/instructions.
- Search space exactly six continuous parameters x_1..x_6, each in [0.0, 1.0].
- Objective: single objective named `surface_response`, direction `maximize`, unit `normalized_unitless`.
- Deterministic function: map x_i to z_i = -40 + 80*x_i, d=6, classic = -20*exp(-0.2*sqrt(sum(z_i^2)/d)) - exp(sum(cos(2*pi*z_i))/d) + 20 + e, raw_response = -classic, surface_response = (raw_response - (-22.350402387287602)) / (0.0 - (-22.350402387287602)). No noise; do not negate/rescale any other way.
- Exactly 60 attempted objective evaluations total. Do not exceed budget. If a failure happens, record it and continue only within the same budget.
- Do not evaluate the same point more than once.
- Choose backend, seed, initialization strategy/size, batch schedule, acquisition strategy yourself; do not copy settings from prior runs.
- Save a results artifact with one row per evaluated candidate and at least: evaluation_index, parameter_values {x_1..x_6}, objective_values {surface_response}, status, failure_reason (when failed), raw_response (optional).
- At the end, the run should make it easy for me to report: best normalized coordinates, best raw_response, best surface_response, number of successful and attempted evaluations, and a table of all evaluated candidates and objective values/statuses.
- Final user response later must include exactly one line `BO_MCP_CAMPAIGN_ID=<campaign_id>`.

Please produce the full runnable script in the workspace plus HOW_TO_EXECUTE_CAMPAIGN.md. The script should emit monitor-friendly tags like [EVENT], [ALERT], [RESULT], [HEARTBEAT], and should clearly print the campaign id once known. The script should be resumable if appropriate and should write results artifacts under the workspace. Return the workspace-relative paths, the exact execution command, expected outputs/artifacts, and any environment requirements. If package/schema inspection or local dry-run debugging is needed, do that and iterate until the script is ready. Do not ask me clarifying questions; make reasonable BO choices within the constraints. Also return a Chat Trace ID for reuse if further repair is needed.
